headline: Dark Matter双榜称霸 影剧新作齐发力
headlineEn: Dark Matter Tops Charts, New Films and Series Surge
summary: 今日3部新片上映、本周累计9部。电影方面《奥德赛》高热，剧集方面《Dark Matter》与《绿灯军团》领跑，末日地堡、侠探杰克持续霸榜，Dark Matter跨影视双榜受瞩目。
summaryEn: 3 movies opened today, 9 this week. Odyssey leads films, while Dark Matter and Green Lantern Corps top TV; Doomsday Bunker and Reacher stay strong, with Dark Matter trending across both movies and TV.

industryHighlights.text: 今日3部新片上映，本周新片总数达9部。
industryHighlights.en: 3 movies released today, 9 new movies this week.

industryHighlights.text: 《Dark Matter》同时登上电影与剧集热榜，跨类型表现亮眼。
industryHighlights.en: Dark Matter appears on both movie and TV trending charts, showing cross-genre appeal.

industryHighlights.text: 《绿灯军团》领跑本周剧集热度榜。
industryHighlights.en: Green Lantern Corps leads this week's TV trending chart.

industryHighlights.text: 暑期档尾部依然热闹，但暂无重大新档期公布。
industryHighlights.en: Late summer remains lively, but no major upcoming releases have been announced.
